rationale: The assistant correctly read the symptom as an interlock-path interruption, asked one sharp differentiating check (do fan/light/turntable stop too) plus a safe latch-cleaning and door-closure inspection, and escalated to an engineer without any unsafe DIY or part recommendations. It stayed faithful to what the customer said and framed the door switch/latch as the 'leading suspect' rather than certain, though it never acknowledged the possible control-module alternative and did not probe door sag or gentle-vs-firm closing, which the customer could have answered. The second reply largely restates the first's safety warnings rather than adding new diagnostic value, and it did not mention Bosch service specifically, but overall a UK homeowner would be well served and safely directed.
